item.title: 1.41.1b1
item.description:
⚠️ BETA RELEASE WARNING

This is an unstable pre-release version intended for testing purposes only.

🔧 Improvements & Stability

  • Choose apps that never quit automatically
    • Turn on "Quit app when last window closes" in Settings > Dock Previews (Dock Interaction section)
    • Click "Select..." next to "Never quit these apps" and pick the apps to keep running
    • The list is empty by default, and the row shows how many apps are excluded
    • Find it quickly through Settings search, for example "exclude" or "last window"

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Apps no longer quit when their last window closes while your Mac is locked
  • Menu bar and background-only apps no longer quit when their window closes
  • Apps with windows on another desktop or still visible on screen no longer quit by mistake
    • DockDoor checks all desktops for remaining windows first, and cancels the quit if one is still open
  • Window Gestures no longer trigger while the screen is locked
